explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault originating upstream. Job 1's assemble_provenance builds evidence_sources with record_id set from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id. The downstream job consumes that exact handoff, so prioritize cannot match evidence ranks to coverage record_ids and emits upstream_rank 0 for every priority record.

Job 2 input evidence_sources has record_id values s01 through s08 while needs/coverage record_id values are n06-r01 through n06-r08.
prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources_df record_id and looks it up using coverage record_id: rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get('record_id', ''), 0).
